tasks.noTasksCanSeed: Create them from the dataset’s files, or paste sample references below.
tasks.seedHint: One reference per line, for samples that are not hosted image files. Hosted images are easier to add with the button above.
tasks.onlyRunning: Tasks can only be seeded while the campaign is RUNNING.
tasks.showing: Showing {shown} of {total}. Full paginated dashboard lands with slice 3.

fromDataset.title: Create tasks from the dataset’s files
fromDataset.body: One task per PNG or JPEG file, and one per DICOM series, hosted on the platform for the campaign’s dataset version. Those that already have a task are left alone, so this is safe to run again.
fromDataset.prefixHint: Optional. Leave empty for every image file and series. A series has no file name, so a prefix leaves series out.
fromDataset.limitHint: Optional. Image files are taken in name order, then series.
fromDataset.noMatch: No hosted PNG or JPEG files or DICOM series match.
fromDataset.preview: {matched, plural, one {# sample matches} other {# samples match}}: {toCreate, plural, one {# new task} other {# new tasks}}{already, plural, =0 {} one {, # already has one} other {, # already have one}}.
fromDataset.held: {held, plural, one {# DICOM series was left out: it has images held for de-identification findings.} other {# DICOM series were left out: they have images held for de-identification findings.}}

seedActions.onlyManagersSeed: Only campaign managers can seed tasks.
seedActions.onlyManagersCreate: Only campaign managers can create tasks.
seedActions.pasteOne: Paste at least one sample reference (one per line).
seedActions.seeded: {created, plural, one {Created # task} other {Created # tasks}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} other { (# skipped as duplicates)}}.
seedActions.limitRange: The limit must be a whole number between 1 and 10,000.
seedActions.forbidden: Your account cannot create tasks in this campaign.
seedActions.noDownloadAccess: You may not download this dataset’s files, so no tasks can be made from them. Ask the dataset’s host for access first.
seedActions.notNow: Tasks cannot be created now: the campaign must be ready or running, and pin a dataset version to take files from.
seedActions.rejected: The sample references were not accepted. Check them and try again.
seedActions.serverError: Something went wrong on the server (error {status}). Try again.

newCampaign.title: New campaign
newCampaign.intro: Define a draft campaign. After this step you’ll attach the dataset, recruit annotators, and move the campaign into READY. State transitions land with #215.
newCampaign.slugPermanentBody: The slug becomes part of the campaign URL and the persistence record. Choose deliberately — slugs cannot be renamed once published.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Human-readable title shown on the campaign card.
form.descriptionHint: Optional. Goal of the campaign, target population, exclusion criteria.
form.taskKindHint: What annotators produce per data point. Drives the tool picker below and the persistence schemaProfile (ADR-0008).
form.unsupported: {kind} isn’t supported for {modalities}. Pick a compatible task kind, or change the dataset.
form.toolHint: Tool the workflow hands annotators off to. Filtered to tools that support the selected task kind.
form.toolHintNoKind: Pick a task kind first; compatible tools appear here.
form.noTool: — No registered tool supports this task kind —
form.labelsHint: One per line, in the order readers see them (2–9; the number keys 1–9 pick them). Write the text readers see, or value | text to set the stored value yourself, e.g. 0 | No DR.
form.nAnnotatorsHint: Range 1–12 (ADR-0009). Default 3 (clinical-validation baseline for IRR). Five+ is recommended for safety-critical or contested findings.
form.nAnnotatorsRange: Annotators per data point must be between {min} and {max}.
form.expectedSamplesHint: Optional. Used only for the cost estimate; not saved with the campaign.
form.costNote: Annotation events, not money. Gates 2–3 run only for samples where gate-1 annotators disagree, so their count is an upper bound. This doesn’t block creating the campaign.
form.licenseHint: License declared on the annotation outputs. SENSITIVE-tier datasets default to custom-restricted (#235 phase 2).
form.costTitle: Cost estimate for {n} annotators per data point
form.costLaterGates: Gates 2–3 — arbitration + expert review, at most
form.costPerSample: Gate 1 alone needs {n} annotation events per sample. Enter the expected number of samples to see the projected total.

picker.label: Dataset
picker.hint: Search the catalog by name or slug. Selecting fills in the dataset id.
